name: stemcell
description: The RAPP brainstem, wherever you need it: one wire over every body it can take (a running brainstem, the Copilot SDK in your process, a headless runtime, a Copilot Studio agent).

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check bin/stemcell.js && for f in src/*.js src/bodies/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile python/agent_runner.py
